## Accordion.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `multiple` :: `single` keeps one item open; `multiple` allows several.
- `value` :: The open item value (`single`) or values (`multiple`).
- `onValueChange` :: Called when the open item or items change.
- `collapsible` :: When single, allow the open panel to be closed.
- `grouping` :: How items are grouped: separate cards, one contained panel, or a flush stack.
- `surface` :: The surface each item sits on: elevated, outlined, vacant, paneled, overlayed or glass.
- `headingLevel` :: The heading level wrapping each item's trigger button.
- `children` :: The items, each an `AccordionItem` with its own trigger and panel.

## AccordionItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: A unique value for this item, used by the accordion's `value`.
- `title` :: The trigger label. Ignored when `trigger` is provided.
- `trigger` :: Custom trigger content, rendered inside the heading button.
- `disabled` :: When true, the item cannot be opened.
- `children` :: The panel content.

## accordion.svelte.ts

### `type AccordionVariant`

How items are grouped visually.

### `type AccordionType`

Whether one or many items can be open.

### `interface AccordionContext`

Shared state between Accordion and AccordionItem.

- `uid` :: The accordion's unique id prefix.
- `variant` :: Visual grouping.
- `multiple` :: True when more than one item may be open.
- `grouping` :: The grouping the root arranges for, plus the surface each item is drawn on.
- `headingLevel` :: The heading level used for each item's trigger.
- `collapsible` :: When type is single, whether the open item can be closed.
- `value` :: The currently open value or values.
- `toggle` :: Open or close an item.
- `isOpen` :: Whether an item is open.

### `const lookClass`

The classes each `grouping` puts on the accordion's own element.
